summary: Inside the main plumbing wall, an unidentified group ('They') slowly worms their way down the grease-black stack pipes. Above them, light fills the hole they made to get inside, marking their point of entry from the room the cops just swept.

what_changes.before: Stationed at the entry hole they made in the plaster and lath.
what_changes.after: Worming their way down the grease-black stack pipes, deeper inside the wall.
what_changes.evidence: slowly worming their way down the grease-black stack pipes

event_hint.one_line: The fugitives crawl down inside the plumbing wall to get away from the cops sweeping the rooms.

uncertain: Who exactly 'They' are — the scene uses only the pronoun.
How far down they get, or whether they reach safety.
